title: Fabric partitions.
officialText:
Fabric partitions that exceed 6 feet (1829 mm) in height, including their finish materials, shall have
adequate strength to resist the following load conditions:
1. A horizontal distributed load of 5 psf (0.24 kN/m2) applied to the partition framing. The total area used to determine the
distributed load shall be the area of the fabric face between the framing members to which the fabric is attached. The total
distributed load shall be uniformly applied to such framing members in proportion to the length of each member.
2. A concentrated load of 40 pounds (0.176 kN) applied to an 8-inch diameter (203 mm) area [50.3 square inches (32 452
mm2)]of the fabric face at a height of 54 inches (1372 mm) above the floor.
SECTION BC 1608
SNOW LOADS
